title: A controlled audit of applied deep learning failures
abstract: We re-run three published deep learning pipelines on a shifted split and attribute each drop to leakage, hyperparameter brittleness, or metric mismatch.

reviews.summary: A useful negative-results paper. The problem is clearly stated and the audit protocol is testable.
reviews.strengths: The method is a straightforward application of existing leakage and shift checks, but the evaluation plan includes baselines and an ablation for each attributed factor.
reviews.weaknesses: The setting is still the original public benchmarks plus a shifted split, so scenario novelty is limited. Only three pipelines are studied.

reviews.summary: The idea is clear but incremental.
reviews.strengths: The research question is bounded and the claims look falsifiable.
reviews.weaknesses: Prior work already reported leakage audits. The method does not introduce a new mechanism. Budget looks feasible on public data.
